question: Sundar starts from point A and drives 12 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 13 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Sundar starts from point A and drives 12 km towards the east.

 He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 13 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fde935df9b532a64a668949f3fb296564ec6f823f4bb36806a5e58086c66af3.png] 

Thus, Sundar has to drive 2km north to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
